subject: Upper Stalfos Room
text: Go through the opposite door in the Upper Stalfos Room to proceed.

evidence.quote:
The Forest Temple - Upper Stalfos Room

Go through the opposite door.

subject: East Stairwell
text: Destroy all three portraits in the East Stairwell to make the Poe Sister appear at the bottom, then defeat her to reveal a chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote:
Once all three
portraits are destroyed, then the Poe Sister will appear at the bottom of the
stairwell.  Defeat her the same way you defeated the previous one.  Once she is
dead, a chest will appear.  Open it to get the Compass.

subject: East Stairwell
text: Climb to the top of the East Stairwell and go through the locked door.

evidence.quote:
Climb back to the top
of the stairwell, and go through the locked door.

subject: Wallmaster
text: Drop down to the floor in the East Twisted Hallway and wait for the Wallmaster to appear, then dodge and kill it.

evidence.quote:
Drop down to the floor and wait for the Wallmaster to appear.  Dodge it and
kill it.

subject: Green Bubbles
text: Two Green Bubbles are found in the hallway at the top of the tall ladder to the right of the entrance door.

evidence.quote:
To the right from the door where you entered the room is a tall
ladder with a doorway at the top.  Go down the hallway inside, where you will
encounter two Green Bubbles.

subject: Green Bubbles
text: Green Bubbles randomly toggle their flame shield on and off, can have their shield disabled by walking into them with a raised shield, and can be shot with arrows when their flame turns off.

evidence.quote:
Green Bubbles are identical to Blue Bubbles, only they do not aggressively
attack and their flame shield randomly toggles on and off.  You can also
disable their shield by walking into them with your shield up.  Shoot the Green
Bubbles with Arrows when their Green Flame turns off, or ignore them.

subject: The Flaming Arrow Room
text: Ride the rotating platforms and shoot an arrow through the center torch flame onto the frozen eyeball switch to melt the ice, activate the switch, and twist the previous hallway.

evidence.quote:
To shoot the switch, you must
ride on the rotating platforms, and shoot an arrow through the flame, and onto
the eyeball switch.  The flaming arrow will melt the ice and activate the
switch.  Once the eyeball switch is activated, then the previous room will
twist itself up.

subject: East Twisted Hallway
text: Drop down the pit in the corner to the right of the twisted hallway after killing the Wallmaster.

evidence.quote:
Run around waiting for the Wallmaster, and kill it
when it lands.  Drop down the pit in the corner, to the right as you jump down
from the hallway.

subject: Crushing Ceiling Room
text: Run south between safe gaps as the crushing ceiling falls, and step on the switch halfway down the hall on the right to open the exit door.

evidence.quote:
Keep running
south down the room, stopping at each gap to spy the next gap and kill any Big
Skulltulas with arrows as needed.  Halfway down the hall on the right is a
switch.  Step on this switch to open the door at the end of the hall.

subject: Yellow Poe Sister
text: Shoot the Poe Sister portrait with an arrow to drop puzzle blocks, push the non-matching fifth block aside, and assemble the other four blocks to reveal and defeat the yellow Poe Sister.

evidence.quote:
Shoot the portrait of the Poe Sister on the wall with an arrow, and the puzzle
blocks hanging above will come down.  Four of the blocks can be pushed together
to form a picture of the yellow Poe Sister.  The fifth is superfluous.  Find
the block which doesn't match (the color should be fairly easy to distinguish),
and push it out of the way before pushing the other blocks together to make the
Poe Sister appear.  Kill her the same way you defeated the other two.

subject: Puzzle Block Room
text: Once the Green Flame is back in place, climb up the ledge near the torch and exit through the door.

evidence.quote:
Once the Green Flame is back in place, climb up the ledge near the torch and go
through the door.

subject: Big Skulltula
text: Kill the Big Skulltula on the ceiling in the East Hallway and exit through the door at the end.

evidence.quote:
Kill the Big Skulltula on the ceiling, and go through the door at the other end
of the hall.

subject: Amy Poe
text: When Amy splits into four versions, identify the real Amy by the little spin she performs upon splitting and shoot her with an arrow.

evidence.quote:
Amy is very different from her sisters.  She will split into four
different versions.  One is the real Amy, the other three are fakes....The real Amy does a little spin when she first splits up.  Shoot
this Amy with an arrow, and she will split into four new Amys.

subject: The Torch Room
text: Defeating Amy brings the final flame into place and raises an elevator in the floor, which leads down.

evidence.quote:
Once Amy dies, then the last flame will come into place, and the elevator in
the floor will rise up.  Go down this elevator.

subject: Spinner Room
text: Push the north side of the left wall handle south, then step on the switch in the northwest room to open a door.

evidence.quote:
As soon as you enter the room, go to the left and grab hold of the north side
of the handle.  Push it towards the south.  Head for the northwest corner of
the room, where there is a small room with a switch inside it.  Step onto the
switch, and a door will open elsewhere in the room.

subject: Spinner Room
text: Push the north side of the right wall handle south, then step on the switch in the eastern alcove to open a gate.

evidence.quote:
As you come out of the room, go to the handle on the right.  Stand on the north
side of the handle, and push it to the south.  Go to the east side of the room,
and enter the small alcove to step onto another switch.  Another gate will open
elsewhere in the room.

subject: Spinner Room
text: Push the eastern side of the wall handle west and enter the southwest room to defeat a Big Skulltula and open a chest containing arrows.

evidence.quote:
Go to the right and to the eastern side of the handle, and push it to the west.
Go to the southwest and into the small room.  Kill the Big Skulltula and open
the chest to find a bundle of arrows.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: In the southwest alcove of the Spinner Room, kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall to the left and retrieve its token with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote:
The Forest Temple - Spinner Room
New Quest Item: Gold Skulltula Token x1 [GS054]...Turn around, and look on the wall to the
left.  Kill the Gold Skulltula and take it's token with the Hookshot.

subject: Spinner Room
text: Push the south side of the handle north, then step on the south switch to open the grating over the northern doorway.

evidence.quote:
Go to the right as you come out of the small alcove, and go to the south side
of the handle.  Push it north.  Go to the south of the room, and step on the
switch.  The grating covering the doorway on the north side of the room will
now open.  Go to the north side of the room and through the doorway.  Enter the
door on the other side.

subject: Phantom Ganon
text: In the first phase, shoot Phantom Ganon with an arrow as he emerges from the brighter painting scattering electricity.

evidence.quote:
To damage Phantom Ganon in this phase, you must shoot
him with an arrow as he emerges from the painting.  The real Phantom Ganon will
make the painting slightly brighter.

subject: Phantom Ganon
text: In the second phase, reflect Phantom Ganon's lightning balls back at him using sword strikes or Bottles to stun him.

evidence.quote:
Phantom Ganon will now begin throwing balls of lightning at you.  To damage him
now, you must stun him by reflecting these lightning balls back at him using
sword strikes (if you're feeling silly, you can also use Bottles).

subject: Phantom Ganon
text: Once Phantom Ganon is stunned on the ground, attack him with the Biggoron Sword or Master Sword, performing only one jump attack before using regular strikes.

evidence.quote:
Once the ball strikes Phantom Ganon, then he will be stunned briefly and fall
to the ground.  At this point, you should run in and begin pummeling him to
death with the Biggoron Sword (or Master Sword if you don't have the Biggoron
Sword yet).  Only do one Jump Attack, then proceed to regular strikes.

subject: Heart Container
text: Defeating Phantom Ganon causes a Heart Container to appear.

evidence.quote:
After he dies, take the Heart Container that appears and enter the beam of
light.

subject: Saria
text: Entering the beam of light transports Link to the Chamber of the Sages, where Saria gives him the Forest Medallion.

evidence.quote:
You will be transported to the Chamber of the Sages, where you will
meet the Sage of the Forest... Saria.  After Saria gives you her power in the
form of the Forest Medallion, you will be transported back outside to the
Kokiri Forest, where a new Deku Tree will sprout.

subject: Pierre the Scarecrow
text: Playing the song invented as Young Link back to the Scarecrow on the northeastern shore of Lake Hylia establishes the Scarecrow's Song to summon Pierre.

evidence.quote:
Return to this Scarecrow now, and play the song for him again.  This song will
now become the Scarecrow's Song, which will summon Pierre the Scarecrow to
various points throughout the game.

subject: Scarecrow's Song
text: If you forgot or never played a song for the scarecrow, Sheik at the Temple of Time teaches how to return to childhood to teach Pierre a new song.

evidence.quote:
If you've forgotten the song that you played for the Scarecrow (or never played
a song for him in the first place), then return to the Temple of Time, where
Sheik will teach you how to return to Link's childhood, letting you teach
Pierre a new song.
